industry.tubes: Precision steel tubes (cold-drawn welded and ERW) and cold-rolled strips go into two-wheelers, cars, trucks, tractors, boilers, cycles and general engineering; TII is India's largest maker. Prices are steel plus a conversion margin; contracts reset steel prices with a 1-3 quarter lag (q1call).
industry.chains: Automotive drive and cam chains (Rombo, Diamond): TII is the market leader in India; door frames and fine-blanked parts for car makers (Hyundai is a large customer of one unit); railway coach sections are tender-driven and currently unprofitable (q4call, q1call).
industry.cycles: Indian bicycle demand is mature and seasonal (school openings in Q1); TII sells BSA, Hercules, Montra and Mach City through 10,000+ dealers and Track & Trail stores. Segment PBIT was a loss in FY24 and 2.4% of revenue in FY26.
industry.ev: Electric commercial vehicles are early: in heavy trucks there were 11 players and TICMPL had ~28% share in FY26 on ~300 trucks a year; in e-SCV 7 players and 27% share in Q4FY26; in e-3W cargo/passenger autos TICMPL billed ~6,700 units in FY26 (q4call, q1call). PM E-DRIVE incentives require localisation; battery-cell prices rose in 2026 on BESS demand.

street.coverage: Thin in public sources. Motilal Oswal (MOSL) publishes a note after every quarter; Geojit after most. Other brokers' notes (if any) were not found in sources dated on or before 30-Sep-2026.
street.method: MOSL: sum of the parts. Standalone business on P/E (30x Jun-27E in Aug-2025, 24x Dec-27E in Feb-2026, 15x FY28E in Aug-2026) and the listed subsidiaries (CG Power, Shanthi Gears) at market less a holding-company discount (30% in 2025 to Feb-2026, 35% in Aug-2026).

brokers.multiple: 15x standalone P/E; listed subsidiaries at a 35% holdco discount
brokers.thesis: Q1FY27 in line despite a 70bp EBITDA-margin miss; TI Medical and CDMO to ramp up in FY27; ~7% standalone PAT CAGR FY26-28E; EV past peak quarterly losses

stockEvents.t: Share price near ₹4,260 (Jun-2024 quarter-end), close to the all-time high; TII then traded at about its look-through value.
Stock rose ~8% to ~₹2,966 after Q1FY27 results.
NSE close ₹2,375 (CG Power ₹854.20, Shanthi Gears ₹579.90): down ~22% from 30-Jun while CG Power fell ~12% (Screener weekly closes).

moat.tubes: Scale and customer approvals in precision tubes (largest Indian maker, plants close to auto clusters): real but cyclical; steel pass-through limits margin power.
moat.chains: Market leader in auto chains with brands in the aftermarket: moderate.
moat.cycles: Brands (BSA, Hercules) in a shrinking, price-led market: weak.
moat.capital: The Murugappa approach to capital (ROIC 44% pre-tax in FY26) and the CG Power turnaround (bought ~2020, now ~₹134,000 cr market value) are TII's real edge; the EV, medical and CDMO bets have not yet shown it.

critiques: Holding-company structure: ~85% of look-through value is a listed stake that investors can buy directly; TII pays only ₹3.50 a share in dividends and keeps funding new ventures.
TICMPL: ₹1,000 cr invested by TII and ~₹1,780 cr by outside investors; still loss-making (EV segment loss ₹147 cr in Q1FY27); conversion terms of the investors' CCPS depend on a future IPO valuation.
Standalone growth is modest (revenue CAGR 7.6% FY22-26; core PAT CAGR ~9% FY23-26) and steel-price lags make margins lumpy.
gaps: Broker notes other than Motilal Oswal and Geojit dated on or before 30-Sep-2026 were not found; Geojit's method and multiple are not in the sources we could read. MOSL's 15x standalone multiple is from a press summary of its 18-Aug-2026 note, not the PDF.

TICMPL's FY26 segment result is not legible in our copy of the AR segment table; TICMPL's standalone P&L (AOC-1) is also not legible. We use the residual block (consolidated less TII, CG Power and Shanthi Gears) instead.
CG Power's capex guidance for FY27 (including CG Semi's OSAT plant) is not in TII's documents; our consolidated capex assumes ~Rs1,100 cr for CG Power.
Standalone other income for FY22 and standalone quarterly EBITDA are not extracted, so standalone EBITDA history starts in FY23 and quarterly standalone profit is shown as PBT.
TII's holding of CG Power shares between Mar-2022 (80.13 cr) and Mar-2023 (88.65 cr) is stepped at Mar-2023 in the discount history (warrant conversion dates not extracted).
The reason for the ~20% fall in TII's share price in Sep-2026 is not in any source we found dated on or before 30-Sep-2026.
Named shareholders above 1% (Jun-2026) were not extracted.
